hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate 30 min SOLID Amazon Uber

Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)

Make your business rules depend on small interfaces they own, and make the database, email and HTTP code depend on those interfaces - not the other way round. Then learn constructor injection, the composition root, and the DIP vs DI vs IoC question that interviewers love.
